# 3buddy

> 3buddy is a full-stack digital development studio and software engineering team based in Kolkata, India. We build high-performance web applications, scalable REST APIs, SaaS platforms, interactive 3D WebGL experiences, and custom enterprise management software systems.

## Technical Stack & Specializations
- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js / WebGL, Responsive Neobrutalist UI/UX
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, Microservices, Python, Java, PHP
- Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, Redis, Mongoose, Prisma ORM
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, n8n Workflow Automations
- Specialized Capabilities: Decentralized Web Apps (DApps), WhatsApp Cloud API Conversational Bots, Interactive 3D Product Showrooms, Business Management ERP Suites
